content: Self-hosting recipe: use Fontsource variable packages (@fontsource-variable/*) or download woff2 directly; serve via Vite public/ or import in CSS entry so Vite fingerprints+hashes the asset. Always pair <link rel=preload> for the primary weight range with font-display: swap (preload alone still causes FOIT). Variable fonts replace 3+ static weight files with one ~80-110KB file. Subsetting (latin + basic punctuation) cuts payload further via unicode-range.
